announcements.headline: Gold Rush Newsletter
announcements.insight: The newsletter follows recent board appointments and a planned reorganisation. Shareholders should monitor for further governance updates.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: Wildcat Petroleum appoints a new Executive Director following its planned directorate reorganisation in June. This board change may signal execution of the earlier strategic review.

announcements.headline: New Executive Director
announcements.insight: The appointment follows the June reorganisation of the Directorate. This board change may signal execution of the planned restructuring.

announcements.headline: Provisional plan re proposed move to Aquis
announcements.insight: Wildcat Petroleum proposes a move to Aquis following its June directorate reorganisation. Shareholders should watch for confirmation of the exchange listing.

announcements.headline: Planned Reorganisation of the Directorate
announcements.insight: The planned directorate reorganisation follows the June appointments of a minerals advisor. Shareholders should watch for further governance changes.

announcements.headline: Appointment of an experienced minerals advisor
announcements.insight: Wildcat Petroleum appointed a minerals advisor following its Khartoum office opening. This board change supports its regional expansion efforts.

announcements.headline: Appointment of an experienced minerals advisor
announcements.insight: Wildcat Petroleum appoints a minerals advisor following its June Khartoum office opening. Shareholders should watch for subsequent operational developments in Sudan.

announcements.headline: Opening of office in Khartoum, Republic of Sudan
announcements.insight: Wildcat Petroleum opens an office in Khartoum. This establishes a physical presence but lacks financial details to assess shareholder impact.
